ids_properties.comment: fast-ion pressure stored as the full directional pressures (IMAS data-dictionary convention); p_fast_reduction=trace

Synthetic, non-proprietary D3D-like baseline (L->H, 3 slices). Written with the IMAS data-dictionary convention: pressure_fast_parallel and pressure_fast_perpendicular hold the FULL directional pressures, not the per-degree-of-freedom thirds that IMAS.jl/FUSE write. p_fast_reduction=trace
